items.description: Potato farming is one of the defining parts of Prince Edward Island's rural landscape and economy. The island's red soil and cool climate make it well suited to potato production.
facts: Prince Edward Island is famous for potatoes
A major part of the island economy

items.description: Calaway Park is a large family amusement park west of Calgary. It offers rides, games, and seasonal entertainment for visitors of all ages.
The Montreal Insectarium is a major insect museum in Montreal and part of the city's Espace pour la Vie network. It introduces visitors to insects, habitats, and biodiversity.
facts: Part of Espace pour la Vie

items.description: Mount Assiniboine is a sharp, pyramid-shaped peak in the Canadian Rockies on the Alberta-British Columbia border. It is one of the most famous mountains in the region.
The South Nahanni River is a wild northern river in the Northwest Territories. It is famous for deep canyons, Virginia Falls, and protected wilderness.
Great Slave Lake is the second-largest lake in Canada and one of the deepest in North America. It sits in the Northwest Territories and shapes the region's travel and climate.
facts: Yellowknife lies on its northern shore

items.description: Haida Gwaii is a remote island archipelago off the coast of British Columbia. It is closely tied to Haida culture and rich Pacific coastal ecosystems.
facts: Includes Gwaii Haanas on the southern islands

items.description: Maligne Lake is a glacier-fed lake in Jasper National Park and one of the best-known landscapes in the Canadian Rockies. Spirit Island makes it especially famous.
facts: Spirit Island is a famous viewpoint

items.description: The Coast Mountains form a dramatic mountain range along the Pacific edge of British Columbia. Their steep slopes, glaciers, and fjords shape the province's western landscape.
facts: Mount Waddington is the highest peak

items.description: The Laurentian Mountains are an ancient mountain range in Quebec north of the St. Lawrence River. Their rounded hills and lakes give the region a classic Canadian Shield look.
facts: One of the oldest ranges in the world
Known for lakes and boreal forest

items.description: The Columbia Icefield is a huge ice-covered area in the Canadian Rockies between Alberta and British Columbia. It feeds several major river systems and attracts many visitors.
facts: One of the largest icefields in the Rockies

items.description: The Mackenzie Mountains are a remote mountain chain in the Northwest Territories and Yukon. They are part of the Canadian Cordillera and remain a rugged wilderness region.
facts: In the Northwest Territories and Yukon

items.description: The Torngat Mountains rise from the far northeast edge of Labrador. Their Arctic scenery and steep peaks make them one of Canada's most dramatic wilderness ranges.
facts: Part of Torngat Mountains National Park
Among Canada's most rugged Arctic ranges
